7 /-! A proved, human-readable checkpoint for the star construction.
8 For a canonical six-vertex graph model with a vertex source sharing
9 a face with every vertex, the actual boundary minus the stated star cuts
10 has a bounded, connected, globally injective planar development preserving
11 its local intrinsic metric, with boundary a finite union of straight segments.
12 Extension to the universal-vertex family remains separate work. -/
13 
14 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
15 
16 open Set
17 
18 /-- The cofacial star has a bounded, connected, nonoverlapping development with polygonal boundary. -/
19 theorem cofacial_star_embedding {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
20     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
21       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
22     (a : frontier P.body) (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
23     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
24     ∃ develop : C(P.UncutSurface a, Plane),
25       Topology.IsOpenEmbedding develop ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (range develop) ∧
26       IsPathConnected (range develop) ∧
27       (∃ edges : Finset (Plane × Plane), frontier (range develop) =
28         ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) ∧
29       ∀ b : P.UncutSurface a, ∃ radius > 0, ∀ c d : P.UncutSurface a,
30         dist (c.val : Space) (b.val : Space) < radius →
31         dist (d.val : Space) (b.val : Space) < radius →
32         dist (develop c) (develop d) = P.surfaceDist c.val d.val := by
33   obtain ⟨T⟩ := graph.exists_regular_cut_tree small_faces a
34   obtain ⟨charts⟩ := graph.exists_cut_tree_charts small_faces a T cofacial
35   let develop : C(P.UncutSurface a, Plane) :=
36     ⟨fun b => charts.develop b.val, graph.develop_continuous small_faces charts cofacial⟩
37   letI : PathConnectedSpace (P.UncutSurface a) := isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.mp
38     (graph.cofacial_uncut_surface_pathConnected small_faces a cofacial)
39   exact ⟨develop, graph.develop_isOpenEmbedding small_faces charts source at_source cofacial,
40     charts.develop_range_bounded, isPathConnected_range develop.continuous,
41     ⟨charts.boundarySegments, graph.develop_frontier_eq_segments small_faces charts source at_source cofacial⟩,
42     graph.develop_locally_isometric small_faces charts source at_source cofacial⟩
43 
44 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
